target_customer: Pharmaceutical and biotech partners paying for small molecule drug discovery collaborations
problem: Finding drug-like molecules that bind a target is slow and expensive with physical screening.
business_model: Research collaborations and partnerships with milestone payments, plus internal pipeline programs

founders.name: Abraham Heifets
founders.background_notes: YC page lists 15 patents or applications.

founders.name: Alex Levy
previous_startups: Atmo (weather forecasting, CEO and cofounder, later)

technical_complexity.rationale: Applying deep convolutional networks to structure based binding prediction was research grade in 2015 and needed validation in wet labs.

defensibility.rationale: Model know how and pharma partnerships helped, but similar methods spread quickly and results depended on target and library.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquirer appeared; the company stayed independent and rebranded in 2025.

market_need_then: Pharma faced high cost and low hit rates in early discovery, and deep learning was newly showing results in other fields.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific, with tagline The Art of Drug Hunting, Powered by ML

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources opened; announced alongside APEX research with NVIDIA scientists

brand_strength.rationale: Atomwise was known in AI drug discovery circles but sources show no brand driven growth; no evidence on the new name yet.

pivots.to: AI superplatform (COSMOS, APEX, EXPO) with own immune and inflammatory programs
pivots.why: Not stated; described on company site

outcome_analysis: Atomwise raised a 45 million Series A in 2018 on a pioneering deep learning approach to drug discovery, signed pharma deals, then reportedly cut about 30 percent of staff in a strategic shift, changed CEO in 2025 and rebranded as Numerion Labs. It is active but has not shown a clear venture scale outcome in the sources found.
notes: Layoff (Endpoints, undated in snippet), CEO change Feb 2025 and a March 2026 Form D of about 19.8M Series D come only from search snippets and are unverified, so no Series D round is recorded. Series A date varies March 7 or 8. Seed amount not found; DCVC led seed per snippets. Competitor snippets (BenevolentAI, Numerate, Schrodinger) came from an undated table so none are listed; no source dated near 2015 found.
